method: Expert estimates of behavioral fidelity, not objective test coverage. Scores may have ±5–10 percentage points or greater uncertainty. Only dated player confirmations qualify as in-game tests; static CI alone does not.

systems.title: City health and disease
gameplayConfirmed: 2026-10-26 player screenshot: Herbalist was advertised as +1 Food in old mod; presentation bug confirmed, not a successful health test.
2026-10-26 screenshot: city health totals display (3/2, net +1), but icon rendered as an empty white square and Herbalist displayed text-only health; UI regression confirmed.
2026-10-26 user reports 'Health seems to be working' following corrected health UI APK; broad smoke test only, not confirmation of every formula, building or resource.
systems.verification: Source-based Diseased combat transmission and all-source immunity/cure-on-immunity hooks implemented in patched engine. Static regression contracts added. Compilation and gameplay tests pending; source contact applicability and biological target eligibility not yet exhaustively verified.
systems.remainingDifferences: City health and temporary epidemic penalties implemented as earlier. Combat transmission of Diseased when an affected attacker/defender survive added; Immune to Disease rejects new Diseased/Plagued promotion from all grant paths and clears existing infections. Remaining: Cure Disease and Healing Salve actions, nonliving immunity/eligibility, all EMM directionality/target edge cases, automatic AC30 Blight/AC35 Pestilence dispatch, unit Death damage, epidemic lair/spell triggers, exact sickness duration and gameplay tests.
